notes: HR reference data for Congolese companies (docs/modules/hr.md HR-03, HR-12). Structure only: identifier types and statutory leave types. No figure is entered until it is confirmed from an official source: a null pattern enforces no format, and a null days value makes the leave type 'Days needed' (requests and accrual refused) until a tenant confirms it. Labels live in lang/{locale}/hr.php (pack.*).
todo: national_id: confirm the national identity document accepted for employees and its number format.
cnss_number: confirm the CNSS affiliation number format before enforcing a pattern.
annual: statutory annual leave (congé annuel) days, how they grow with service and age (Code du travail, 2002, as amended), with the effective date.
maternity: statutory maternity leave (congé de maternité) weeks and pay, with the effective date.
sick: statutory sick leave (incapacité de travail) rules and pay.
circumstantial: the congé de circonstance events and days (marriage, birth, death), with legal references.
